'''Zirulast''' was a [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="UAA" /> located in the [[Zirulast system/Legends|Zirulast system]], a part of the [[Belasco sector/Legends|Belasco sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The star was situated on the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the [[Belasco system/Legends|Belasco system]] as well as the [[New Apsolon system/Legends|New Apsolon system]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> Zirulast was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Zirulast|same name]]. The latter was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Temolak]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="UAA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The star Zirulast was created for ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'', a [[2003]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] sourcebook for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="UAA" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Zirulast [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the star itself, in grid square P-11.<ref name="TEA" />
